source_record_id.notes: Resolved by this task's offline-proof follow-up (see radialsystem-berlin-01-offline-proof). The programme list page's own 'list' view renders one row PER PERFORMANCE OCCURRENCE (not one row per production): each row's own <a href="/en/veranstaltungen/{slug}/?date={unixTimestamp}"> carries BOTH the production's permalink slug AND a second, source-authored '?date=' disambiguator for that specific occurrence, in one single retained href attribute -- not a combination of two separately-located page facts, so this is DIRECT_SOURCE, not DETERMINISTIC_CONTEXT. Compound id = '{slug}__{date-query-value}' (e.g. 'zweiland__1787857200' for Zweiland's 27 Aug 2026 21:00 performance). Empirically verified against the full retained fixture: all 28 in-scope occurrence rows (single-production '/en/veranstaltungen/{slug}/' detail pages only -- the one '/en/festivals/' umbrella-page row is out of scope, see collector_assessment notes) yield genuinely unique compound keys, including all 6 of Zweiland's own occurrences. tests/radialsystem.test.mjs asserts this uniqueness deterministically and offline.

blockers.description: RESOLVED by this task's offline-proof follow-up: a single production/slug genuinely carries multiple performance dates/times (real one-to-many), but the programme page's own 'list' view already expands one row per occurrence with its own '?date=' query disambiguator, so ingestion/radialsystem/observation-adapter.mjs emits one Observation per occurrence row using the compound source_record_id '{slug}__{date-query-value}' (see field_assessment.source_record_id). A second, narrower MINOR note for any future collector build: the programme's own '<span class="tag">' category markup mixes disciplines (Dance/Exhibition/Workshop/Lecture/Family Format/Party/Music theatre alongside Concert/Concerts/Musik) and must be filtered to genuinely music-relevant tags (filterMusicEventCards()) before Observations are emitted, and the one '/en/festivals/{slug}/' festival-umbrella row on the retained page is a structurally different, unconfirmed page shape correctly excluded rather than parsed as a single production.
